product.name: Quantix Digital ThermoProbe
product.description: The Quantix Digital ThermoProbe delivers precise temperature readings for laboratory and field applications. Its compact body houses a high‑resolution sensor that measures from –20 °C to 120 °C with ±0.3 °C accuracy. A clear LCD displays the value and the probe can be paired via Bluetooth 4.0 to a companion app for data logging. The unit is powered by a rechargeable 5 V USB‑C battery that lasts up to 48 hours on a single charge. Built with a stainless‑steel probe tip and a durable ABS housing, it resists corrosion and is suitable for use with chemicals and in sterile environments.
